definition.name: Varied captured Cargo graphs without optional catalogues

steps.name: Install the existing bounded compiler namespace and pinned bindings
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Read only this run's identity-checked existing native products
Check varied source, selected graph, integrity and signed-result refusal controls
Execute four offline signed graph selections through the minimal normal Rust recipe
Retain bounded varied-graph component and source observations including failures

with.name: rust-dependency-matrix-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-dependency-matrix/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-dependency-matrix/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-dependency-matrix/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-dependency-matrix/graph-*/capture.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-dependency-matrix/graph-*/build/*.json
